channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: I went to Saks Fifth Avenue to see why the iconic department store was struggling. Hours later, it filed for bankruptcy.
item.description: Hours before Saks Global filed for bankruptcy, I visited the Fifth Avenue flagship store.

item.title: She and 4 friends quit their jobs to make a mobile game. Now, they've raised $30 million, led by A16z and Arcadia.
item.description: Irem Sumer and her four friends have spent two years working on "Match Valley." Now they've got millions of dollars in backing from Silicon Valley.

item.title: Suspended Ford employee who heckled Trump sparks over $800,000 in GoFundMe donations
item.description: Fundraising campaigns for a Ford employee who was suspended after shouting at President Trump have raised hundreds of thousands.

item.title: Grok stops users from making sexualized AI images after global backlash
item.description: Grok will no longer be allowed to edit photos of real people to show them in sexualized or revealing clothing.

item.title: Ukraine's new defense minister just outlined how dire its troop shortage has become
item.description: In his remarks at Ukraine's parliament, Mykhailo Fedorov warned of nearly 2 million Ukrainians dodging the military draft.

item.title: I moved to Thailand last year and continue seeing tourists make the same 5 mistakes
item.description: Andre Neveling said he was so intimidated by local food on his first trip to Thailand that he ate Burger King for a week.

item.title: Russia could face costly write-offs in Venezuela on its oil assets and arms loans, think tank analyst says
item.description: Western sanctions and weak oil prices are already squeezing Russia's coffers, pressuring funds used to sustain the war and the broader economy.

item.title: Trump places a 25% tariff on high-end computing chips, and said more duties may be coming for the semiconductor industry
item.description: The tariff will cover hardware central to the AI boom like Nvidia's H200 processor and AMD's MI325X chips, with some exemptions.

item.title: Mandy Moore says motherhood has reshaped her friendships
item.description: "I've had to sort of mourn in a way, not the loss of those friendships, but like how they've changed," Mandy Moore said.

item.title: McDonald's CEO says these 3 food trends will define 2026
item.description: Chris Kempczinski said fiber, sweet and spicy flavor combinations, and innovative drinks will reign supreme this year.
